lines.text: What happens when a 31-billion parameter AI takes on Silicon Valley's giant supercomputers?
An Indian AI lab named Sthanika just shocked the world.
Instead of spending hundreds of millions on brute force, they re-engineered the decision cortex.
Inside the model, trillions of neural weights prune away noise at blinding speed.
When tested on grueling real-world decision benchmarks,
tying for first place globally with the biggest models on Earth.
Proving that intelligent architecture beats pure compute every single time.
Follow COEP DSAI for the real future of artificial intelligence.
